With 2 page counters already on Mazemind Tome, they could have used it to scry 1 (for {T}) or pay {2},{T} to draw a card and put a 3rd page counter on it. All their lands are tapped, so they can't pay {2} for the draw mode, but they could still tap Mazemind Tome to scry 1 for free (just {T} and adding a page counter). Scrying for free is pure upside that helps find key cards like lands or threats. Declining a free scry is a small but clear mistake.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to activate Mazemind Tome or any abilities during the combat step.
annotations.betterLine: Tap Mazemind Tome to scry 1 (adding a 3rd page counter) since it costs no mana, providing free card selection.

annotations.description: MiMo Stoic cast Sol Ring into open blue mana from Gem25F Johnny, who had 8 mana available (including Izzet Signet and multiple Islands) and was holding Aethersnatch. Sol Ring is a powerful mana rock, but casting it when an opponent has 6+ blue mana open and could steal it is risky. More importantly, Gem25F Johnny successfully cast Aethersnatch to steal the Sol Ring, meaning MiMo Stoic lost a card and gave an opponent a Sol Ring. MiMo Stoic had other productive plays available - Thopter Engineer (3 mana, creates a token), Battlemage's Bracers (3 mana), or Rip Apart (2 mana to deal with a threat) - that would have been less painful if countered/stolen. Playing the Mountain first and then casting a different spell would have been better sequencing.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Sol Ring with Gem25F Johnny having significant open blue mana including the ability to cast Aethersnatch (4UU).
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain first, then cast a less critical spell like Thopter Engineer or Battlemage's Bracers. Save Sol Ring for a turn when opponents have less open mana or are tapped out, or at minimum cast it alongside other spells to make stealing it less impactful.

annotations.description: Used Aetherize, a premium mass-bounce spell, to bounce only 2 modest creatures (Abstruse Archaic 3/4 and Solemn Simulacrum 2/2) while at 40 life. Only preventing 5 damage at full life. Worse, bouncing Solemn Simulacrum gives Grk41F Vet another ETB land-fetch trigger when replayed.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Aetherize to bounce Abstruse Archaic and Solemn Simulacrum, preventing 5 damage at 40 life.
annotations.betterLine: Take the 5 damage (going to 35 life, still very healthy) and save Aetherize for a much more impactful attack later in the game, such as when multiple large creatures attack or when life total is more pressured.

annotations.description: Discarded Worn Powerstone despite having zero mana rocks and a hand full of expensive 6+ mana cards (Steel Hellkite, Dreamstone Hedron, Soul of New Phyrexia). Worn Powerstone would provide critical acceleration. Solemn Simulacrum is also decent ramp/value that was discarded.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Worn Powerstone and Solemn Simulacrum
annotations.betterLine: Discard Ancient Stone Idol (10 mana, very hard to cast without ramp) and Bonders' Enclave (just another colorless land when already at 8 lands). Keep Worn Powerstone to accelerate into 6-drops and Solemn Simulacrum for additional ramp.

annotations.description: With Wastes in hand, playing the land first would give 6 mana, enabling Dreamstone Hedron - a critical ramp piece that taps for 3 colorless mana. Grk41F Vet has lost significant mana rocks (Worn Powerstone, etc.) and desperately needs ramp to cast their expensive hand (Steel Hellkite, Soul of New Phyrexia). Abstruse Archaic is a decent body but its copy ability has limited immediate value with no other colorless activated/triggered abilities to copy.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Abstruse Archaic (4 mana) instead of ramping with Dreamstone Hedron
annotations.betterLine: Play Wastes from hand first to reach 6 mana, then cast Dreamstone Hedron to accelerate toward casting 6+ mana threats in subsequent turns

annotations.description: Activating Bonders' Enclave's draw ability before Abstruse Archaic has resolved means there's likely no creature with power 4+ on the battlefield (Suspicious Bookcase is 0/4). Additionally, the player should play Wastes from hand before spending mana to maximize available resources for the turn, especially with expensive cards like Steel Hellkite, Dreamstone Hedron, and Soul of New Phyrexia in hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Bonders' Enclave draw ability for 3 mana while Abstruse Archaic was still on the stack, before playing Wastes from hand.
annotations.betterLine: Play Wastes from hand first, let Abstruse Archaic resolve (giving a 3/4 creature - still not power 4+), then use the {T}: Add {C} ability instead, or simply tap Bonders' Enclave for colorless mana to help cast future spells.

annotations.description: Grk41F Vet had a Wastes in hand but did not play it before casting their spell. Playing the land first would have been free value - an extra mana source costs nothing and should always be done before committing to spells.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast It That Betrays without first playing Wastes from hand
annotations.betterLine: Play Wastes first, then cast It That Betrays

annotations.description: Grk41F Vet activated Ruins of Oran-Rief's +1/+1 counter ability, but there are no creatures on their battlefield at all, let alone a colorless creature that entered this turn. There is no valid target for this ability. This wastes the tap of a land that could have produced {C} mana instead.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose to activate Ruins of Oran-Rief's second ability to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature that entered this turn, with no valid target.
annotations.betterLine: Tap Ruins of Oran-Rief for {C} mana instead, or leave it untapped for future use.

annotations.description: Grk41F Vet declined to activate Bonders' Enclave during combat to draw a card. They control It That Betrays (11/11) satisfying the power 4+ requirement, and had untapped lands (Forge of Heroes, Wastes, Blast Zone) to pay the {3} activation cost. The mana was unlikely to be used for anything else meaningful during combat.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to use any activated abilities during combat.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Bonders' Enclave to draw a card, since the mana was available and there was no downside to doing so during combat.

annotations.description: Discarding Plains over Secret Rendezvous. Secret Rendezvous gives an opponent 3 cards which is a significant downside in multiplayer, making it likely the weakest card in hand. Plains provides a future land drop that could help cast Duplicant (6 mana) sooner.

annotations.betterLine: Discard Secret Rendezvous, which has a significant downside of giving an opponent 3 cards, while keeping Plains for a needed land drop toward casting Duplicant (6 mana) with only 7 mana sources currently.
